comparison.objective: Load two equal tubes into opposite centrifuge-rotor pockets.
comparison.physical_skill: Pick, orient, and insert two cylinders into separated pockets while applying an implicit balance rule.
comparison.success_condition: Both tubes are seated in pockets 180 degrees apart; an unbalanced pair scores zero.
comparison.reason: This tests balanced multi-object insertion rather than adjustment of a mechanical response under repeated physical trials.
